description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ganangolla (Block 06), Thamankaduwa D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No. 120291
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of notices calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It deals specifically with land ownership, possession, and interest claims for various parcels of land across multiple districts (Polonnaruwa, Kandy, Gampaha, Ratnapura). The notices reference cadastral maps, land surveys, and the process for determining land title, which falls squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
